responsibility: Declares a small public interface for the tree-to-RTL expansion subsystem in `cfgexpand.cc`. It exposes helpers for reconstructing tree expressions from GIMPLE assignments, estimating stack-frame size for a cgraph node, and assigning RTL to parameters, allowing other expansion- and debug-related code to query or participate in the lowering of GIMPLE into RTL.
same_name_distinction: Declares only a few externally used helpers from the expansion subsystem, such as reconstructing assignment RHS trees and parameter/stack queries; unlike gcc/cfgexpand.cc, it does not implement the GIMPLE-to-RTL expansion pass itself.
